subject: Temporary SLA coverage redistribution request — Bluewave Analytics (P1/P2)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SLA coverage redistribution for Bluewave (P1/P2)

Team —

Quick summary: Bluewave (BW-4392) has flagged elevated overnight latency and an uptick in P2 tickets tied to their data ingestion pipeline since we started the DC migration last week. They are currently on the Standard Support package with P1 = 1 hour, P2 = 6 hours. We have a hiring gap in the EU/APAC rotations for the next three weeks which reduces our available on-call headcount for overnight coverage.

Ask: I would like approval to temporarily redistribute coverage for Bluewave so we can: 1) adjust P2 overnight to an extended response window for no more than 21 days; 2) add an overlapping on-call shadow for P1 during peak hours (US-PST 02:00–10:00 UTC) using volunteers from SRE; and 3) publish a short, jointly-approved customer communication with the revised temporary escalation path.

Rationale: this is a short, controlled change to avoid repeatedly missing the P2 window during the migration/cutover. We propose adding a single senior SRE shadow to the escalation list (SRE pager) and using Smart Routing to send high-priority requests to Dedicated capacity in us-west where capacity is stable. We will cap the duration to three weeks and offer a credit adjustment to Bluewave as a gesture of goodwill (TBD).

Attached: proposed-rotational-plan.pdf (detailed volunteer schedule) and bluewave-runbook-draft.md (new escalation path + playbook).

If possible, a quick ACK from Laura/Naomi today would let us send a clear timeline to Bluewave and route the SRE shadow.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA coverage redistribution for Bluewave (P1/P2)

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. A few technical items I want to flag before we sign off:

- The P2 uptick is mostly caused by repeated prefix cache misses during the DC switch and a backlog in the prefetch layer. We can mitigate with an aggressive temporary prefix caching rule for Bluewave (low risk) and an autoscale bump for their dedicated slice for the 12–72 hour peak windows.
- I'll prepare a fallback routing rule: route P1 to Dedicated us-west first; if that fails, fallback to hosted cold pool with reduced token-per-cost cap. That will preserve latency SLOs for P1.

Operational ask: who owns the outbound comms? Sales or Customer Reliability? We should include the concrete credit figure in the first comms so Bluewave can decide quickly.

On approvals I can volunteer a senior SRE (Rohit) as the shadow but need the leadership sign-off on the SLA amendment window and the credit threshold.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Marcus —

Thanks for the heads up. We are seeing the same symptoms on our side: delayed ingestion acknowledgements and a few stalled checkpoint jobs. Important clarifications for us: 1) what is the exact proposed P2 extended window in hours? 2) will Bluewave be required to open an incident via the portal to trigger the SRE shadow, or will you proactively create a support ticket on our behalf? 3) what credit are you proposing so this is reflected in our procurement review this week?

We are open to a temporary tweak if there is a clear end date and a single owner for escalation. Please include the runbook link and the name/phone of the SRE shadow in the next note.

—Sofia
Sofia Ramirez

ops@bluewave.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA coverage redistribution for Bluewave (P1/P2)

Sofia —

Thanks for the quick reply and the clear asks. Answers below:

1) Proposed P2 overnight extension: up to 10 hours (from 6 to 10) only between 00:00–08:00 PDT, with firm end date of 2028-07-31. P1 remains 1 hour and will be routed to the SRE shadow first.

2) We will proactively open a support incident on your behalf if we detect a P1-class alert during the carveout window; you do not need to open the portal. We will also provide a single phone escalation for the shadow (Rohit Sharma: +1 415 555 0244).

3) Credit proposal: 10% service credit for affected billing period, subject to approval. If leadership prefers a different amount, we can update the comms.

Runbook: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/bluewave-sla-runbook (summary attached).

Next steps requested from Redwood leadership: an ACK on the 10-hour P2 temporary window + approval of the 10% credit offer. If Laura/Naomi sign off, we'll publish a joint notice and route Rohit to the SRE pager this afternoon.

Marcus

- Approve a 10% service credit for the affected billing period (deal BW-4392).
- Require twice-weekly check-ins with Bluewave (Marcus + Karthik) while the carveout is active; doc the check-ins in the linked Drive folder.
